# oxframe

> Procedural animation in Rust. Scenes are `async fn`s; every awaited animation takes time. Render to video with a CLI, preview in a browser editor with hot reload, or try it in the playground at https://oxframe.dev/playground.

Install: `cargo install oxframe-cli`, then `oxframe init my-video && cd my-video && oxframe dev`. Update: `cargo install oxframe-cli --force`, then `oxframe upgrade` in each project.

Projects created with `oxframe init` include AGENTS.md and a Claude Code skill (`.claude/skills/oxframe/`) with the API cheat sheet and workflow. Use `oxframe snapshot --at <seconds>` to render PNG frames and check visual changes; do not run `oxframe dev` in an agent session (interactive server).

## Start here

- [Welcome](https://oxframe.dev/docs): what oxframe is
- [Install and first project](https://oxframe.dev/docs/getting-started): Rust, ffmpeg, `oxframe init`, `oxframe dev`

## Guide (in order, each lesson builds on the previous one)

- [1. Your first animation](https://oxframe.dev/docs/guide/hello): a scene, a node, `.to(value, seconds).await`
- [2. In order, or all at once](https://oxframe.dev/docs/guide/together): `all`, `sequence`, `wait_for`
- [3. Shapes, colors, transforms](https://oxframe.dev/docs/guide/shapes)
- [4. Easing](https://oxframe.dev/docs/guide/easing)
- [5. Text](https://oxframe.dev/docs/guide/text)
- [6. Groups and layout](https://oxframe.dev/docs/guide/groups): children, flexbox
- [7. Tweak timing in the editor](https://oxframe.dev/docs/guide/editor): `wait_until`, `tune!`, `ease!`, meta.json
- [8. Signals](https://oxframe.dev/docs/guide/signals): `.bind`, derived values
- [9. Drawing and morphing](https://oxframe.dev/docs/guide/drawing): paths, `end`, morph
- [10. Randomness and background tasks](https://oxframe.dev/docs/guide/random): `random()`, `spawn`
